title: steenisia pleurocarpa
intro: Steenisia pleurocarpa, commonly known as the Steenisia tree or the Malayan Steenisia, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. This plant is traditionally used in Southeast Asian medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Steenisia pleurocarpa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body from infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Steenisia pleurocarpa include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
